short: Who acts: the identity domain crate
is: The identity domain crate: users, accounts, actor identities, handles, custody keys, profiles and public records, with the ports that store and resolve them; I/O-free, built on kernel only (shared allowed).
conventions: Depends on kernel only (shared allowed), never on workflow, the domain façade, an adapter or a driver; doc links up a layer are plain code text.
Every element mirrors a design glossary page (`entities/` in the corpus); the page pointer lives in this node's `refs`, never in a doc comment.
Stub modules are allowed, and documented honestly as stubs.

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: kernel, uuid, cid, serde, zeroize (custody keys), async-trait, anyhow, thiserror, derive_more, strum; dev-deps proptest, chrono

fs.name: proptest-regressions/
fs.role: committed proptest regressions, at the path of each property file under src/ (handle/at_handle)

refs.title: Identities — the Actor Super-Table, Kind-Checked References & the Polymorphism Ban
Libraries as Composition — the Approved Crate Set and the Newtype Derive Rules
refs.governs: newtype derive rules: path-qualified derives, thiserror owns errors, Deref dropped, FromStr/From derived only where the inner type carries the rule, IdError retired; strum allowed here exact-pinned with token tests; dev-dep proptest — Handle/AtHandle properties beside their leaves (x/proptests.rs), proptest-regressions/ committed

notes: See also: the design corpus glossary — `entities/` in ZurNetwork/zurfur-design, indexed by `docs/design-index.md`.
